headline: STL @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 2.47 at MIL 3.89, with a projected total of 6.36. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: STL moved -1.05 runs while MIL moved -0.09, changing the projected margin by -0.96 runs. The projected total fell -1.14, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Dustin May has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for William Contreras, Jake Bauers, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
